supporting_observations.claim: The alerted periodic HTTPS activity is visible from 13:38 through 14:08 UTC: proxy CONNECT records show repeated requests at roughly five-minute intervals to update.chartmate-imaging.net, with successful tunnels and some failed attempts.

Sysmon and Windows filtering records associate these proxy connections with C:\Users\ben.carter\AppData\Local\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe running as ben.carter, including connections at 13:38, 13:43, 13:47, 13:52, 13:58, 14:03, and 14:08 UTC.

The observed process and approximate five-minute checking pattern are consistent with the inventory's named ChartMate updater explanation, but the evidence does not establish that this particular executable and destination are the approved updater.

There are material discrepancies from the documented ChartMate details: the inventory specifies C:\Program Files\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe and update.chartmate-imaging.com, whereas the observed process is under Ben Carter's AppData path and the proxy records show update.chartmate-imaging.net.
The supplied records first show the associated ChartMate connection at 13:38 UTC; they do not show a corresponding connection at the alert's stated 13:30 start.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT tunnel metadata and status, not the encrypted HTTPS request contents or downloaded payload.
The supplied records do not establish the updater executable's file signature, hash, provenance, or whether it was modified.
The evidence shown does not establish whether the .net destination is an authorized ChartMate endpoint or a redirect/alternate endpoint.
claims_not_established: Whether the AppData cmupdate.exe is a genuine, authorized ChartMate updater.
Whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is controlled or authorized by ChartMate.
Whether any of the successful HTTPS tunnels transferred malicious content or data.
Whether the periodic activity began at 13:30 UTC; the first corresponding connection in the supplied records is at 13:38 UTC.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect the updater executable's hash, digital-signature and file provenance information, and compare it with a known-good ChartMate release.
Verify the .net hostname with ChartMate or an authoritative software/vendor source; obtain DNS, certificate, and proxy inspection details for the destination if available.
Review endpoint and proxy telemetry covering the full 13:20–14:20 UTC window, including any executable update/download events and the activity leading up to the first observed connection.
unrelated_findings: Separate ticket: WS-BCARTER-01 made an SMB connection to FILE-HD-01 followed by an NTLM network logon recorded as ANONYMOUS LOGON. This is outside the alerted HTTPS activity and does not determine this alert's disposition. Records: T015-00253, T015-00255, T015-00257.
